faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about our event, tickets, exhibitors, and more.
faq.emptyState: We are gathering commonly asked questions. Please come back later.
faq.contactTitle: Have any questions? Just send it to us!

0.q: When and where will {eventTitle} take place?
0.a: {eventTitle} will be held on {eventDate}, from {eventTime}, at {eventLocation}.

1.q: How do I get tickets to attend the event?
1.a: You can get your tickets through our official website. Simply click the Get Ticket button and follow the registration process. E-tickets will be sent to your email and WhatsApp after purchase.

2.q: How much does a ticket cost?
2.a: Ticket prices vary depending on the ticket type and promotional period. Please visit our Ticket page for the most up-to-date pricing information. Don't miss our early bird and pre-sale promotions!

3.q: Can I get a refund if I can't attend?
3.a: All ticket sales are final. There are no refunds or exchanges once a ticket has been purchased. Please review our Ticket Refund and Return Policy for more details.

4.q: What should I bring to the event?
4.a: Please bring your e-ticket (digital or printed) to be exchanged for a badge at the registration counter. We recommend bringing business cards if you're looking to connect with vendors for corporate events or group activities.

5.a: The event is open to everyone! Whether you're an HR professional, event organizer, company representative looking for team building activities, travel enthusiast, or outing service provider, you're welcome to attend!

6.q: What services and destinations will be showcased?
6.a: You'll discover a variety of outing destinations, team building activities, corporate event venues, travel packages, outdoor adventures, resorts, and unique group experiences. Visit our Exhibitors page for the full list.

7.q: Can I book services directly at the event?
7.a: Yes! Many exhibitors offer exclusive event promotions and allow on-site bookings. This is a great opportunity to find deals on corporate outings, team building packages, and group travel directly from providers.

8.q: How can I become an exhibitor?
8.a: To showcase your outing services, venues, or travel packages, please visit our Exhibitor Registration page or contact our team via WhatsApp for booth information.

9.q: Are there any seminars or presentations at the event?
9.a: Yes! We organize seminars and presentations covering topics like effective team building, corporate event planning, trending outing destinations, and employee engagement activities. Check our Rundown page for the schedule.

10.q: Is this event suitable for finding team building activities?
10.a: Absolutely! This is the perfect place to discover team building providers, compare packages, and find unique activities for your company's outing. Meet vendors face-to-face and discuss your specific needs.

11.q: How can I become a sponsor or media partner?
11.a: We welcome sponsorship and media partnership opportunities. Please contact us via WhatsApp or {email} to discuss partnership packages.

12.q: Is there parking available at the venue?
12.a: Yes, the venue provides parking facilities. However, we recommend arriving early as parking spaces may fill up quickly during peak hours. You may also consider using public transportation or ride-sharing services.

13.q: Can I take photos or videos at the event?
13.a: Personal photography and video recording for non-commercial purposes are allowed. However, professional or commercial recording requires written permission from the organizer. Please refer to our Event Policy for more details.

14.q: How can I stay updated about the event?
14.a: Follow us on Instagram {'@'}{instagram} for the latest updates, exhibitor announcements, and exclusive content. You can also check our News page.

15.q: How do I contact the organizer?
15.a:
You can reach us through:

  • WhatsApp: Click here to chat
  • Email: {email}

Visit our Help Center for more contact options and quick links to useful information.
